resolution.note: feat(slice): run observers and rule tests before a lead-authored commit (t-vwsz7hs)

title: Run observers and rule tests before committing a lead-authored slice
body: Outcome: with `--worker none`, `krn slice run` runs the brief's observers and `test/rules` on the lead's uncommitted edits before the commit stage and stops with their exit code, so a rule failure (t-mmh9ff6: raw U+FEFF caught by invisible-format-source only in verify preflight, after commit and close) never costs a fixup and rebase. Proof: a slice-run test with a failing rule fixture stops before commit with no new commit.
